results.comment: Permissions showed Location as allowed. On the Location screen, “Allow only while using the app” was initially checked; tapping “Don’t allow” changed it to checked, and no warning appeared. After returning via the visible back controls, the fixture showed “NOT_REQUESTED: Location is optional.” and “RATIONALE: true”; Refresh left that status unchanged. After Use location feature, the exact status became “REVOKED: Location unavailable. Continuing without location.” with “RATIONALE: true”. The fixture remained responsive and its controls remained visible and clickable.
